description: Use this when the signed-in owner has a request, idea or feedback for the Suara team who make their posts: what to post about, a promotion or event coming up, a change to a post (say which postId), a new look, more or fewer posts. Write the request clearly and completely in the owner's words. It sends a message to the team (nothing is posted or changed right away); the team replies later, so check with get_suara_replies.

message.description: What the owner wants, in full

postId.description: The post it's about, if any

name: send_to_suara
title: Send something to Suara
